package com.acme.inventory;

import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThat;

import java.time.Month;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Disabled;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.DisplayName;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Nested;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.junit.jupiter.params.ParameterizedTest;
import org.junit.jupiter.params.provider.CsvSource;

class ReorderPolicyTest {

    private final ReorderPolicy policy = new ReorderPolicy(20, 12);

    @Test
    void shouldReorderWhenBelowMinimum() {
        assertThat(policy.shouldReorder(Item.active("SKU-1"), 19)).isTrue();
    }

    @Test
    void shouldNotReorderDiscontinuedItems() {
        assertThat(policy.shouldReorder(Item.discontinued("SKU-2"), 0)).isFalse();
    }

    @ParameterizedTest
    @CsvSource({"7, 12", "12, 12", "13, 24"})
    void reorderQuantityRoundsUpToCaseSize(final int shortfall, final int expected) {
        assertThat(policy.reorderQuantity(shortfall)).isEqualTo(expected);
    }

    @Nested
    @DisplayName("Seasonal items")
    class Seasonal {

        @Test
        void peakSeasonDoublesMinimum() {
            assertThat(policy.minimumFor(Month.DECEMBER)).isEqualTo(40);
        }
    }

    @Test
    @Disabled
    void legacyMinimumTable() {
        // port of the 2019 table { INV-88 }; @Test kept so it shows up as skipped
        assertThat(policy.minimumFor(Month.JANUARY)).isEqualTo(15);
    }
}
